suite.doc:
Custom Call Automation Test Suite Automated phone call scenario using STF devices: 1. Auto-select two available STF devices 2. Connect both via STF (serial → IP:PORT) 3. Switch Phone A to 2G 4. Phone A calls Phone B 5. Phone B answers after 5 seconds of ringing 6. Call lasts 30 seconds and ends 7. Collect Anritsu trace (PCAP)
This test simply calls the Python function from custom_call.py which contains all the scenario logic.
